name: pah-decline-v1
plan: docs/PAH_DECLINE_PLAN.md (final choices by Jaison, committed before the run)
model: M1: Tobit decline of ln(PAH sum) vs time since spill with total organic carbon and campaign, per oiling class; M0: no-change baseline
target: soil PAH sum half-life (years) in oiled marsh, by SCAT oiling class
validation: FINDINGS 22 (docs/FINDINGS_2026-11-11.md): M1 beats the M0 no-change baseline on whole held-out stations (ln-MAE 0.592 vs 0.631; difference -0.039, 90% interval -0.066 to -0.010); 90% prediction interval covers 0.89 of held-out cells. Validated WITHIN Deepwater Horizon only (one spill).
interval_method: 90% interval on the class half-life from the 90% interval on the decline rate k (results/pah_decline/by_oiling_class.csv)
held_out_units: whole stations (196 of 200 stations held out; never split rows within a station)

training_range.region: northern Gulf of Mexico marsh (LA, MS, AL, FL)

limits: Outcome is the PAH sum (physical loss plus degradation). A decline in the sum with no decline in the PAH/hopane ratio means physical loss (erosion, burial, removal), not degradation. One spill; no treatment variable; 56 stations have no SCAT class within 100 m (unknown).
